title: Ravana talks to Seetha
introduction: In this chapter Ravana entices Seetha with wealth, gems, sovereignty over all wives of Ravana.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे विम्षः सर्गः
Thus completes 20th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
स ताम् परिवृतां दीनां निरानन्दां तपस्विनीम् |
साकारैर्मधुरैर्वाक्यैर्न्यदर्शयत रावणः
verses.iast:
sa tām parivṛtāṃ dīnāṃ nirānandāṃ tapasvinīm |
sākārairmadhurairvākyairnyadarśayata rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Ravana conveyed in significant words to that Seetha who was surrounded by ogresses, wretched, without happiness and pitiable.

verses.devanagari:
मां दृष्ट्वा नागनासोरु गूहमाना स्तनोदरम् |
अदर्शनमिवात्मानं भयान्नेतुं त्वमिच्चसि
verses.iast:
māṃ dṛṣṭvā nāganāsoru gūhamānā stanodaram |
adarśanamivātmānaṃ bhayānnetuṃ tvamiccasi
verses.translation: "You are with thighs like the trunk of an elephant. Seeing me covering your breasts and belly, you desire obtaining disappearance of self due to fear.

glosses.meaning: (You are) With thighs like the trunk of an elephant

verses.devanagari:
कामये त्वाम् विशालाक्षि बहुमन्यस्व मां प्रिये |
सर्वाङ्गगुणसम्पन्ने सर्वलोकमनोहरे
verses.iast:
kāmaye tvām viśālākśi bahumanyasva māṃ priye |
sarvāṇ^gaguṇasampanne sarvalokamanohare
verses.translation: "O wide eyed one! You are endowed with bodily excellencies, pleasing to all people. I desire you. O lovable one! respect me."

glosses.meaning: you are endowed with bodily excellencies

verses.devanagari:
नेह केचिन्मनुष्या वा राक्षसाः कामरूपिणः |
व्यपसर्पतु ते सीते भयम् मत्तः समुत्थितम्
verses.iast:
neha kecinmanuṣyā vā rākśasāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
vyapasarpatu te sīte bhayam mattaḥ samutthitam
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Here there are no humans or ogres with ability to change form. Let your fear caused due to me be removed."

glosses.meaning: or ogres with ability to change form

verses.devanagari:
स्वधर्मो रक्षसां भीरु सर्वथैव न संशयः |
गमनं वा परस्त्रीणाम् हरणम् सम्प्रमथ्य वा
verses.iast:
svadharmo rakśasāṃ bhīru sarvathaiva na saṃśayaḥ |
gamanaṃ vā parastrīṇām haraṇam sampramathya vā
verses.translation: "O one with fear! Obtaining women belonging to others or abducting by force is the righteous deed for ogres by all means. There is no doubt in this."

glosses.meaning: obtaining parastriiNaam = women belonging to others

verses.devanagari:
एवं चैतदकामां तु न त्वां स्प्रक्ष्यामि मैथिलि |
कामम् कामः शरीरे मे यथाकामं प्रार्तताम्
verses.iast:
evaṃ caitadakāmāṃ tu na tvāṃ sprakśyāmi maithili |
kāmam kāmaḥ śarīre me yathākāmaṃ prārtatām
verses.translation: "O Seetha! It is like this. desire very much may behave in whatever way it likes in my body. But I will not touch you without lust."

glosses.meaning: may behave in whatever way it likes

verses.devanagari:
देवि नेह भयम् कार्यम् मयि विश्वसिहि प्रिये |
प्रणयस्व च तत्वएन मैवम् भूः शिकलालसा
verses.iast:
devi neha bhayam kāryam mayi viśvasihi priye |
praṇayasva ca tatvaena maivam bhūḥ śikalālasā
verses.translation: "O queen of my heart! In this matter fear is not to be made. O love! Believe in me. Truly become with love. Do not become absorbed in sorrow like this."

glosses.meaning: fear is not to be made

verses.devanagari:
एकवेणी धराशय्या ध्यानं मलिनमम्बरम् |
अस्थानेऽप्युपवासश्च नैतान्यौपयिकानि ते
verses.iast:
ekaveṇī dharāśayyā dhyānaṃ malinamambaram |
asthāne'pyupavāsaśca naitānyaupayikāni te
verses.translation: "Single plait, the bed of ground,mediation,dirty cloth,fasting at an inappropriate time - all these are not useful to you."

verses.devanagari:
विचित्राणि च माल्यानि चन्दनान्यगरूणि च |
विविधानि च वासांसि द्व्यान्याभरणानि च
महार्हणि च पानानि शयनान्यासनानि च |
गीतम् नृत्तं च वाद्यं च लभ मं प्राप्य मैथिलि
verses.iast:
vicitrāṇi ca mālyāni candanānyagarūṇi ca |
vividhāni ca vāsāṃsi dvyānyābharaṇāni ca
mahārhaṇi ca pānāni śayanānyāsanāni ca |
gītam nṛttaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca labha maṃ prāpya maithili
verses.translation: "O Seetha! After getting me gain wonderful garlands, sandals, Agallochums, a variety of cloths and best ornaments, the best drinks, beds and seats, song and dance and musical instrument."

verses.devanagari:
स्त्रीरत्नमसि मैवम् भूः कुरु गात्रेषु भूषणम् |
मां प्राप्य हि कथम् नु स्यास्त्वमनर्हा सुविग्रहे
verses.iast:
strīratnamasi maivam bhūḥ kuru gātreṣu bhūṣaṇam |
māṃ prāpya hi katham nu syāstvamanarhā suvigrahe
verses.translation: "You are a gem among women. Do not be like this. Make decoration on your limbs. O one with a good body! Getting me how will you become unsuited for luxuries?"

glosses.meaning: You are a gem among women
O one with a good body!

verses.devanagari:
इदम् ते चारु सम्जातम् यौवनम् व्यतिवर्तते |
यदतीतं पुनर्नैति स्रोतः शीघ्रमपामिव
verses.iast:
idam te cāru samjātam yauvanam vyativartate |
yadatītaṃ punarnaiti srotaḥ śīghramapāmiva
verses.translation: "This your youth born beautifully is passing away, whichever youth is quickly passing away will not come back again like the flow of water."

verses.devanagari:
त्वां कृत्वोपरतो मन्ये रूपकर्ता स विश्वसृक् |
न हि रूपोपमा त्वन्या तवास्ति शुभदर्शने
verses.iast:
tvāṃ kṛtvoparato manye rūpakartā sa viśvasṛk |
na hi rūpopamā tvanyā tavāsti śubhadarśane
verses.translation: "O one with auspicious appearance! The creator of form, that creator of the world, Lord Brahma has made you and stopped - I think thus. There is not another who is equal to your appearance."

verses.devanagari:
त्वाम् समाअसाद्य वैदेहि रूपयौवनशालिनीम् |
कः पुमानतिवर्तेत साक्षादपि पितामहः
verses.iast:
tvām samāasādya vaidehi rūpayauvanaśālinīm |
kaḥ pumānativarteta sākśādapi pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Obtaining you endowed with beauty and youth, which man even if he is Lord Brahma himself will disregard (leave) you."

glosses.meaning: (even if he is) Lord Brahma himself

verses.devanagari:
यद्यत्पश्यामि ते गात्रम् शीतांशुसदृशानने |
तस्मिंस्तस्मिन् पृधुश्रोणि चक्षुर्मम निबध्यते
verses.iast:
yadyatpaśyāmi te gātram śītāṃśusadṛśānane |
tasmiṃstasmin pṛdhuśroṇi cakśurmama nibadhyate
verses.translation: "O one with face like that of moon! O one with broad hips! Your whichever limb I see, my eye is getting tied in that that limb."

glosses.meaning: O one with face like that of moon!

verses.devanagari:
भव मैथिलि भाया मे मोहमेनम् विसर्जय |
बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणामाहृतानामितस्ततः
सर्वापामेव भद्रं ते ममाग्रमहिषी भव |
verses.iast:
bhava maithili bhāyā me mohamenam visarjaya |
bahvīnāmuttamastrīṇāmāhṛtānāmitastataḥ
sarvāpāmeva bhadraṃ te mamāgramahiṣī bhava |
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Become my wife. Leave this ignorance. In all my many best women brought from here and there, become foremost consort. Let there be auspicious to you."

verses.devanagari:
लोकेभो यानि रत्नानि सम्प्रमथ्याहृतानि वै
तानि मे भीरु सर्वाणि राज्यम् चैतदहं च ते |
verses.iast:
lokebho yāni ratnāni sampramathyāhṛtāni vai
tāni me bhīru sarvāṇi rājyam caitadahaṃ ca te |
verses.translation: "O timid one! Whatever gems that have been brought by force, all those, my this kingdom and also myself belong to you."

verses.devanagari:
विजित्य पृथिवीं सर्वां नानानगरमालिनीम्
जनकाय प्रदास्यामि तव हेतोर्विलासिनि |
verses.iast:
vijitya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ nānānagaramālinīm
janakāya pradāsyāmi tava hetorvilāsini |
verses.translation: "O charmful lady! Conquering the entire earth together with chain of various cities for your sake, I can give to king Janaka.

glosses.meaning: together with chain of various cities

verses.devanagari:
नेह पश्यामि लोकेऽन्यम् यो मे प्रतिबलो भवेत्
पश्य मे सुमहद्वीर्यमप्रतिद्वन्द्वमाहवे |
verses.iast:
neha paśyāmi loke'nyam yo me pratibalo bhavet
paśya me sumahadvīryamapratidvandvamāhave |
verses.translation: "In this world I do not see another one who is equally matched to me. See my very great power."

verses.devanagari:
असकृत्सम्युगे भग्ना मया विमृदितध्वजाः
अशक्ताः प्रत्यनीकेषु स्थातुं मम सुरासुराः |
verses.iast:
asakṛtsamyuge bhagnā mayā vimṛditadhvajāḥ
aśaktāḥ pratyanīkeṣu sthātuṃ mama surāsurāḥ |
verses.translation: "Suras and Asuras defeated with broken flags by me in war many times are powerless to stand in an army against me."

verses.devanagari:
इच्छ मां क्रियतामद्य प्रतिकर्म तवोत्तमम्
सप्रभाण्यवसज्यन्तां तवांगे भूषणानि च |
साधु पश्यामि ते रूपम् सम्युक्तं प्रतिकर्मणा
verses.iast:
iccha māṃ kriyatāmadya pratikarma tavottamam
saprabhāṇyavasajyantāṃ tavāṅge bhūṣaṇāni ca |
sādhu paśyāmi te rūpam samyuktaṃ pratikarmaṇā
verses.translation: "Desire me! Now let your best decoration be made. On your body let ornaments also with great brilliance be fit. I will see well your form together with decoration."

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिकर्माभिसम्युक्ता दाक्षिण्येन वरानने |
भुम्क्ष्व भोगान्यथाकामं पिब भीरु रमस्व च
verses.iast:
pratikarmābhisamyuktā dākśiṇyena varānane |
bhumkṣva bhogānyathākāmaṃ piba bhīru ramasva ca
verses.translation: "O one with best face! O timid one! With consideration enjoy luxuries according to your desire together with decoration. Drink. Rejoice."

glosses.meaning: O timid one! daakshiNyena = with consideration

verses.devanagari:
यथेच्छम् च प्रयच्छ त्वं पृथिवीम् वा धनानि च |
ललस्व मयि विस्रब्धा धृष्टमाज्ञापयस्व च
verses.iast:
yatheccham ca prayaccha tvaṃ pṛthivīm vā dhanāni ca |
lalasva mayi visrabdhā dhṛṣṭamājJṇāpayasva ca
verses.translation: "You donate land and wealth according to your wish. With confidence behave freely in my matter. Fearlessly order also."

verses.devanagari:
मत्र्पसादाल्ललन्त्याश्च ललन्तां बान्धवास्तव |
बुद्धिं ममानुपश्य त्वम् श्रियम् भद्रे यशश्च मे
verses.iast:
matrpasādāllalantyāśca lalantāṃ bāndhavāstava |
buddhiṃ mamānupaśya tvam śriyam bhadre yaśaśca me
verses.translation: " By my grace with your sporting, tour relatives will also sport. O auspicious one! You see my wealth and my fame."

verses.devanagari:
किं करिष्यसि रामेण सुभगे चीरवाससा |
निक्षिप्तविजयो रामो गतश्रीर्वनगोचरः
व्रती स्थण्डिलशायी च शङ्के जीवति वा न वा |
verses.iast:
kiṃ kariṣyasi rāmeṇa subhage cīravāsasā |
nikṣiptavijayo rāmo gataśrīrvanagocaraḥ
vratī sthaṇḍilaśāyī ca śaṇ^ke jīvati vā na vā |
verses.translation: "O beautiful one! What can you do with Rama clad in tatters, with lost hope of victory, with gone fortune. Roaming in forests, observing austerities and also sleeping on floor, I doubt if Rama is alive or not."

verses.devanagari:
न हि वैदेहि रांस्त्वां द्रष्टुं वा प्युपलस्स्यते
पुरोबलाकैरसितैर्मे घोर्ज्योत्स्नामिवावृताम् |
verses.iast:
na hi vaidehi rāṃstvāṃ draṣṭuṃ vā pyupalassyate
purobalākairasitairme ghorjyotsnāmivāvṛtām |
verses.translation: "O Seetha, Rama indeed does not get opportunity even to see you like moonlight covered by dark clous with cranes at the front."

verses.devanagari:
न चापि मम हस्तात्त्वां प्राप्तुमर्हति राघवः
हिरण्यकशिपुः कीर्तिमिन्द्रहस्तगतामिव |
verses.iast:
na cāpi mama hastāttvāṃ prāptumarhati rāghavaḥ
hiraṇyakaśipuḥ kīrtimindrahastagatāmiva |
verses.translation: "Like Keerthi got by Hiranyakasipu from Indra's hand, Rama is not suited to get you from my hands."

verses.devanagari:
चारुस्मिते चारुदति चारुनेत्रे विलासिनि
मनो हरसि मे भीरु सुपर्णः पन्न्गं यथा |
verses.iast:
cārusmite cārudati cārunetre vilāsini
mano harasi me bhīru suparṇaḥ panngaṃ yathā |
verses.translation: "O one with a beautiful smile! O one with beautiful teeth!O one with beautiful eyes! O charmful one! O timid one! You are stealing my heart like a serpent stolen by Garuda.

glosses.meaning: O One with a beautiful smile!

verses.devanagari:
क्लिष्टकौशेयवसनाम् तन्वीमप्यनलम्कृताम्
त्वां दृष्ट्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रतिं नोपलभाम्यहम् |
verses.iast:
kliṣṭakauśeyavasanām tanvīmapyanalamkṛtām
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā sveṣu dāreṣu ratiṃ nopalabhāmyaham |
verses.translation: "You are Wearing a silk cloth in a bad condition. You are emaciated. Even though you have not decorated, seeing you I am not getting happiness in my wives."

glosses.meaning: (You are) wearing a silk cloth in a bad condition
Even though you have not decorated

verses.devanagari:
अन्तः पुरविनासिन्यः स्त्रियः सर्वगुणान्विताः
यावन्त्यो मम सर्वासामैश्वरम् कुरु जानकि |
verses.iast:
antḥ puravināsinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvaguṇānvitāḥ
yāvantyo mama sarvāsāmaiśvaram kuru jānaki |
verses.translation: "O Seetha! whoever women living in gynaeceum endowed with all virtues, have sovereignty on all of them."

verses.devanagari:
मम ह्यसितकेशान्ते त्रैलोक्यप्रवराः स्त्रियः
तास्त्वां परिचरिष्यन्ति श्रियमप्सरसो यथा |
verses.iast:
mama hyasitakeśānte trailokyapravarāḥ striyaḥ
tāstvāṃ paricariṣyanti śriyamapsaraso yathā |
verses.translation: "O one with black hair! My those women and apsarasas who are the best among the three worlds will serve you like the goddess of wealth."

glosses.meaning: O one with black hair! mama = my

verses.devanagari:
यानि वैश्रवणे सुभ्रु रत्नानि च धनानि च
तानि लोकांश्च सुश्रोणि मां च भुम्क्ष्व यथासुखम् |
verses.iast:
yāni vaiśravaṇe subhru ratnāni ca dhanāni ca
tāni lokāṃśca suśroṇi māṃ ca bhumkṣva yathāsukham |
verses.translation: "O one with beautiful hips! O one with beuatiful eyebrows! Enjoy according to your comfort whatever gems and wealth belonging to Kubera, all those three worlds and me."

verses.devanagari:
न रामस्तपसा देवि न बलेन विक्रमैः
न धनेन मया तुल्यस्तेजसा यशसापि वा |
verses.iast:
na rāmastapasā devi na balena vikramaiḥ
na dhanena mayā tulyastejasā yaśasāpi vā |
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Rama is not equal to me by austerity, not equal by might; not equal by strength, not equal by wealth, by brilliance and by fame."

glosses.meaning: Rama na tulyaH = is not equal

verses.devanagari:
पिब विहर रमस्व भुंक्ष्व भोगान् |
धननिचौअम् प्रदिशामि मेदिनीम् च |
मयि लल ललने यथासुखम् त्वम् |
त्वयि च समेत्य ललन्तु बान्धव्वस्ते
verses.iast:
piba vihara ramasva bhuṅkṣva bhogān |
dhananicauam pradiśāmi medinīm ca |
mayi lala lalane yathāsukham tvam |
tvayi ca sametya lalantu bāndhavvaste
verses.translation: "O playful one! I will give hordes of wealth and land. You drink. Roam freely and play. Enjoy luxuries. Sport according to comfort in me. Your relatives may sport together in you."

verses.devanagari:
कनकविमलहारभूषिताङ्गी |
विहर मया सह भीरु काननानि
verses.iast:
kanakavimalahārabhūṣitāṇ^gī |
vihara mayā saha bhīru kānanāni
verses.translation: "O timid one! With body decorated with gold colored, pure garlands, roam with me in forests born at sea shore filled with groups of flowered trees and with humble bees."

glosses.meaning: with body decorated by gold colored
filled with groups of flowered trees
